```{r}
# loading libraries


library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(stats)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(formatR)
library(papaja)
library(report)

```


```{r}
# simple time series test



data=data.frame(
  date=seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2026-12-31"), by="month"),
           value=c(100, 102, 141, 160, 128, 200, 202, 204, 260, 208, 300, 320, 250, 202, 140, 160, 138,
                   200, 202, 204, 265, 208, 359, 380))

head(data)
```





```{r}
# convert date column to date format

data$date<-as.Date(data$date)
head(data)
```





```{r}
# plot time series

ggplot(data, aes(x=date,  y=value))+
  geom_line(color="blue")+
  labs(
    title="time series data",
    x="date",
    y="value"
  )+
  theme_minimal()
```






```{r}
# Decompose time series data

# create a time series object

ts_data<-ts(data$value, frequency = 12, start = c(2025, 1))

# decompose time series

decomposed_data<-decompose(ts_data)

# plot the decompostion

plot(decomposed_data)

```


```{r}
# Autocorrelation function

acf(ts_data, lag.max=20)
```


```{r}
# partial autocorrelation of data

pacf(ts_data, lag.max=20)
```




```{r}
# check stationality using (Augmented dickey Fuller test (ADF))

adf_results<-adf.test(ts_data)  # if p-value<5%, the series is stationary

print(adf_results)

# series not stationary since p-value is greater than 5%



```



```{r}
# if p-value> 5%, we take first difference

diff_data<-diff(ts_data)
plot(diff_data, main=" differenced time series data", col="red")
adf.test(diff_data)
```



```{r}
# if p-value> 5%, we take 2nd difference

diff2_data<-diff(diff_data)
diff3_data<-diff(diff2_data)
diff4_data<-diff(diff3_data)
plot(diff4_data, main=" differenced time series data", col="red")
adf.test(diff4_data)
```


```{r}
# buid ana ARIMA model

# fit arim,a model

arima_model<- auto.arima(diff4_data)
summary(arima_model)
```


```{r}
# forecasting future format

forecast_arima<- forecast(arima_model, h=6)
head(forecast_arima)
# forecast next 6 periods

plot(forecast_arima)
```
